instructions: Apply the bundled Supabase schema and Edge Function to the configured project.
Create a dedicated bearer token and install it in both the CMS secret store and the Supabase function secrets.
Install the newsletter source and subscriptions dashboard with the deployed function URL.
checks: The CMS only stores the source configuration and private API key reference.
Newsletter requests do not require a CMS user identity.
The connector schema stays private to anon and authenticated Supabase roles.
The connector deployer owns Supabase project credentials; the CMS source only stores its generated API key reference.
resources: Private newsletter schema and Edge Function
review: Keep the newsletter schema private to anon and authenticated roles.
Do not expose Supabase service-role or secret keys to browser code.
Use the CMS source proxy for all backoffice access.
syncNote: This integration creates a stateless CMS source. Supabase owns newsletter subscription rows.
